html:
If you are staying in Da Nang and looking for a private car tour to Son Tra Peninsula, Vietlook Travel offers a comfortable and flexible four hour city tour by private car with a professional local driver.

Son Tra Peninsula is one of the most beautiful natural areas in Da Nang, famous for its coastal roads, green forests, and panoramic views of the city and sea.

Flexible Da Nang to Son Tra Private Car Tour

With the Da Nang to Son Tra and return Da Nang City private car tour, you can explore Son Tra Peninsula at your own pace without following fixed group tours.

This tour allows you to:

  • Choose your preferred departure time

  • Enjoy scenic coastal roads and viewpoints

  • Stop anytime for photos and sightseeing

  • Adjust the itinerary based on your interests

Suggested Places to Visit on Son Tra Peninsula

During the four hour tour, you may choose to visit:

  • Linh Ung Pagoda with the Lady Buddha statue

  • Son Tra Peninsula viewpoints

  • Coastal roads and beaches

  • Photo stops overlooking Da Nang City

The itinerary is flexible and can be adjusted depending on weather and traffic conditions.

Professional Driver and Comfortable Vehicles

Vietlook Travel provides:

  • Experienced and polite drivers familiar with Son Tra routes

  • Clean, modern, and well maintained vehicles

  • Strong air conditioning and safety seat belts

  • Assistance with luggage if needed

Vehicle options include sedan cars, sport utility vehicles, minivans, and luxury vehicles.
